title: Lytell and Signorelli's recording of Sister Kate
summary: La Rocca says Lytell and Signorelli took his whole Sister Kate arrangement and recorded it, and that his correspondence with Piron predates Clarence Williams coming to New York.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Now, what about Lytel and Signorelli and their recording of Sister Kate?

They took the whole arrangement in total and recorded it. That's what they did. And they made Sister Kate. Now I had correspondence with A.J. Perron. I just can't find it at present. I would like to include that in there to show you that Perron and I correspond before Francis Williams ever came to New York.
